_artifact.name: portable_checks.json
_artifact.purpose: Portable consistency evidence; not SAP activation, ATC, runtime or coverage

checks.name: artifact_header_present
checks.detail: Every ABAP source starts with the Artifact/Purpose/Modification log header.

checks.name: object_names_max_30
checks.detail: Every object name is 30 characters or fewer.

checks.name: short_text_max_60
checks.detail: Every SE24 short text (ABAP Doc shorttext) is 60 characters or fewer.

checks.name: no_select_star
checks.detail: No SELECT * (explicit field lists only).

checks.name: fae_guarded
checks.detail: Every method with FOR ALL ENTRIES checks the driver table for INITIAL first.

checks.name: no_hardcoded_company_code
checks.detail: No hard-coded company code '1000' in production code.

checks.name: concrete_classes_final
checks.detail: Every concrete public class is FINAL.

checks.name: tests_harmless_short
checks.detail: Every test class is RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

checks.name: test_method_names_max_30
checks.detail: Every test method name is 30 characters or fewer.

checks.name: commit_only_in_sanctioned_objects
checks.detail: COMMIT WORK only in the store (LUW owner) and the e-mail channel (BCS).

checks.name: no_write_lists
checks.detail: Programs use ALV / HTML output, never WRITE lists.

checks.name: no_inline_texts
checks.detail: No user-facing text or technical value as a literal outside declarations (3677 literals scanned; allow-list tools/literal_allowlist.txt).

checks.name: message_constants_exist
checks.detail: 402 message-number constants point to existing ZCD_OPS messages (a shared message may be named by several apps).

checks.name: name_lengths
checks.detail: Objects, CDS entities, DDLS / SRVD / DCLS names, methods, attributes, types, local classes and local data 30 characters at most; transparent tables 16; message class 20; table fields 30.

checks.name: method_names
checks.detail: Methods are snake_case, never start with a data prefix (lv_, it_, mo_, gc_, ...) and have 30 characters at most (test methods included).

checks.name: test_path_every_class
checks.detail: Every class has its own test include, or a row in tools/test_path_register.csv naming the covering test include (which mentions the class) or an exemption with its reason.

checks.name: osql_doubles_complete
checks.detail: A test include of a class with Open SQL uses cl_osql_test_environment / cl_cds_test_environment and doubles every table the tested methods (and their helpers) read or write; injected test seams and osql-not-reached markers excluded (static, best effort - dynamic table names are not resolved).

checks.name: no_real_dao_in_tests
checks.detail: A test include of a class without SQL injects doubles when the class gets a DAO / the store from a factory, and never creates a real DAO / store.

checks.name: pcre_only
checks.detail: Regular expressions use PCRE only (pcre = / PCRE); POSIX (regex =, FIND / REPLACE ... REGEX, CL_ABAP_REGEX POSIX) is obsolete since ABAP 7.55.

checks.name: no_cp_patterns
checks.detail: Patterns are PCRE matched to the complete value (ZCL_CD_OPS_UTIL=>PCRE_MATCH): no CP / NP comparison and no option = 'CP' / 'NP' range row in code (comments and literal contents ignored).

checks.name: messages_used
checks.detail: Every ZCD_OPS message (config/zcd_ops_messages.md) is raised by production code: a message-number constant that production code reads, MESSAGE eNNN(zcd_ops) or NUMBER = literal.

checks.name: params_used
checks.detail: Every parameter-name constant (gc_param, gc_param_prefix of a types interface) is read by production code.

checks.name: constants_used
checks.detail: Every types-interface constant is referenced by code, a test or CDS (documentation does not count); message numbers, check codes, parameter names and defaults one by one, other structures as value domains.

checks.name: param_definitions_complete
checks.detail: 116 delivered definitions in 4 areas (config/param_definitions.csv): every parameter name the code reads (gc_param constants, standalone gc_param_* constants, every enumerated run-time name) is defined and every definition is read, the area is the one ZCL_CD_OPS_PARAMS_CA derives from the prefix, the default equals the default the code delivers, flags are BOOL, no read is compared with an off token, ZCL_CD_OPS_PARAM_SEED is generated from the seed files.

checks.name: cds_abap_parity
checks.detail: 27 CDS literal(s) / ABAP constant pairs agree (XBLNR rule, dashboard date windows, credit indicator, reversal reason, completed run statuses, stale thresholds).

checks.name: abaplint_clean
checks.detail: abaplint (v758 syntax, SAP stubs from abaplint/deps): 0 issue(s) over 378 files.

checks.name: atc_equivalent_clean
checks.detail: ATC-equivalent abaplint rule set: 3 finding(s) over 1318 file(s), 3 documented exemption(s).
